jobs.title: Civil Works/Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary
The Civil Works/Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for overseeing both the design and implementation of civil infrastructure projects, as well as managing surveying activities in the field. This role requires extensive fieldwork and collaboration with project teams to ensure projects are delivered with precision, quality, and integrity. The role involves the use of advanced surveying tools and technology, as well as ensuring adherence to engineering standards and regulations.
Duties and Responsibilities
1. Project Planning and Design
Develop detailed project plans, including scope, timelines, and resource allocation.
Collaborate with engineers and project managers to design civil works (roads, bridges, drainage systems, utilities).
Conduct feasibility studies and site assessments to determine project viability.
Prepare accurate engineering drawings and specifications in accordance with regulatory standards.
2. Surveying and Fieldwork
Conduct site surveys and inspections using equipment such as total stations, GPS receivers, and 3D laser scanners.
Analyze and interpret survey data to generate contour plans using Civil CAD software.
Incorporate survey data into civil infrastructure designs.
Ensure the accuracy of topography, boundaries, and measurements on-site.
3. Site Management
Oversee construction activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications and quality standards.
Coordinate with subcontractors and suppliers to facilitate smooth execution of project phases.
Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, address issues, and ensure project integrity.
Ensure proper implementation of survey data during construction phases.
4. Quality Assurance and Control
Ensure compliance with engineering standards, safety regulations, and quality control procedures.
Conduct material testing and maintain accurate project documentation.
Prepare progress reports and recommend corrective actions when necessary.
Document changes in project scope and manage approvals.
5. Team Collaboration and Leadership
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to achieve project goals.
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technical staff.
Ensure clear and effective communication among all team members and stakeholders.
Review and approve construction methods and materials for compliance.
6. Budgeting and Resource Management
Prepare and manage project budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation.
Monitor expenditures and implement cost control measures where appropriate.
Oversee procurement processes and ensure ethical purchasing practices.
Recommend cost-saving measures while maintaining quality standards.
7. Regulatory Compliance
Ensure all projects comply with local, state, and federal regulations.
Obtain required permits and approvals from authorities.
Conduct environmental assessments as needed.
8. Problem-Solving and Decision-Making
Identify and resolve project challenges while maintaining compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
Make informed decisions regarding project modifications or design changes.
Implement risk management strategies and address safety concerns on-site.
9. Documentation and Reporting
Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including contracts, change orders, and reports.
Prepare and present progress reports to stakeholders.
Document best practices and lessons learned for continuous improvement.
10. Equipment Maintenance and Calibration
Ensure surveying equipment is maintained and calibrated for accurate data collection.
Coordinate equipment repairs and replacements as necessary.
Stay informed of technological advancements to enhance equipment performance.
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in civil engineering and/or surveying.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Civil CAD, and other engineering software.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Familiarity with construction materials, methods, and surveying equipment.
Others
Working Conditions
This position involves extensive fieldwork and site visits, including travel to various project locations.
Some physical activities, such as walking long distances, climbing, or carrying equipment, may be required.
Split between office and fieldwork. Fieldwork involves outdoor site visits with varying weather and terrain.
Frequent travel to project sites, sometimes requiring overnight stays. Flexibility in travel is expected.The role is physically demanding, requiring good fitness for site work. Strong problem-solving skills and clear communication are essential.

jobs.title: Principal
jobs.description:
BALIMO COLLEGE SCHOOL OF NURSING
PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS POSITION IS FOR A PRINCIPAL TO BE BASED IN BALIMO COLLEGE CAMPUS IN WESTERN PROVINCE, PNG. BEFORE APPLYING, PLEASE ENSURE THAT YOU HAVE THE RELEVANT NURSING AND ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, AND THE ABILITY TO RELOCATE TO WESTERN PROVINCE
ORGANISATION:
Balimo College
POSITION:
Principal - Balimo College School of Nursing
LOCATION:
Balimo, Western Province
COMMENCEMENT:
January 2025
DURATION:
12-month contract with a 3-month probationary period
REMUNERATION:
Competitive remuneration package offered
REPORTING TO:
Chair, Balimo College Governing Council
ABOUT BALIMO COLLEGE:
Balimo College is Western Province’s newest Higher Education Institute. In 2025, Balimo College opened the new School of Nursing and commenced a 4-year Bachelor of General Nursing program. The College’s vision is to advance Western Province by providing high-quality education, research and community engagement. The institute will foster pathways for teachers and nurses who are committed to improving access to vital services in Western Province.
Balimo College is a safe and supportive place for graduates and other professionals across the Western Province catchment region to return for life-long learning and ongoing professional development. The College will develop a community of education and health professionals committed to innovation, excellence and community advancement; by being the training College of choice for Papua New Guineans.
Balimo College is a PNG Sustainable Development Program (SDP) initiative delivered in partnership with KTF, Divine Word University, and Western Sydney University. Balimo College School of Nursing is an affiliate of Divine Word University.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Balimo College School of Nursing Principal is responsible for upholding the College’s Vision, Mission, Core Values, Educational Philosophy and Goals. The Principal will operate within the Balimo College School of Nursing leadership structure as determined by the Chair, Governing Council, to disseminate strong, effective educational leadership, and manage all information technology within the parameters identified in this position description.
The Principal will have an in-depth knowledge of the ethos and purpose of the Balimo College School of Nursing and the principles by which it operates. The Principal will have a firm understanding of the Western Province health context and the objectives of Balimo College School of Nursing to create pathways for rural communities into the field of nursing.
KEY SELECTION CRITERIA
Applicants must demonstrate that they are able to meet the following Key Selection Criteria:
Master’s Level Health qualification.
Bachelor’s degree in nursing.
Education qualification.
Minimum 8 years of teaching experience.

Here you’ll make a difference
Save the Children is the world’s largest independent child rights development organization, making a difference to children’s lives in more than 100 countries. From emergency relief to long-term development, Save the Children secures a child’s right to health, education, and protection. At Save the Children, we attract bright and big-hearted people who are inspired to make a difference. Together, we are fearless in our pursuit of making lasting change for the children and communities who need it most. In Papua New Guinea, Save the Children currently implement programs in the sectors of health, education, child protection, child rights governance and livelihoods. The Child Nutrition and Social Protection Project is an 18-month project implemented from March 2025 to December 2026 in the provinces of East New Britain and Simbu.
Here your skills will be valued
Role Purpose
Reporting to the Deputy Team Leader – Operations, the Provincial Coordinator will lead the implementation of all activities in his/her assigned province. This role will focus on coordinating and overseeing all project activities at the provincial level, ensuring effective implementation, stakeholder engagement, and alignment with Save the Children and Government of PNG national objectives.
Key Areas of Accountability
Program Management and Delivery
Oversee the implementation of activities in the assigned province, including project participant registration, sensitization, and trainings.
Manage the recruitment, training, and supervision of Community Development Workers (CDW) in coordination with district teams and People & Culture.
Coordinate with District Officers and CDWs to ensure timely and quality implementation of project activities.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for activity delivery; address any bottlenecks at the provincial level. Develop/refine provincial implementation plans, ensuring alignment with national roll-out strategies.
Support the MEAL team in any post-distribution monitoring (PDM) activities in the province
Contribute to the analysis of project data and the development of recommendations for improving project performance at the provincial level
Ensure adherence to project timelines, budgets, and donor requirements for the province. Ensure timely and accurate reporting on project activities, including financial and narrative reports
Operational Management
Oversee the establishment and management of offices in the province. Manage day-to-day operations at the provincial level, including logistics, procurement, and administrative functions.
Coordinate with the Deputy Team Leader and national office to ensure alignment of operational processes and systems (e.g., supply chain, human resources, finance).
Ensure compliance with Save the Children's policies, procedures, and donor requirements.
Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination
Serve as the primary liaison with provincial government officials, Payment Service Providers (PSPs), and other key stakeholders to facilitate smooth project implementation.
Represent Save the Children in relevant coordination meetings and forums at the provincial level. Maintain strategic relationships with provincial-level stakeholders and partners.
Coordinate closely with government/counterpart provincial coordinators.
Capacity Building and Support
Identify capacity-building needs for provincial and district-level staff and coordinate training opportunities. Provide mentoring and support to District Officers and CDWs.
Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practices across districts within the province.
General
Comply with Save the Children policies and practice with respect to child safeguarding, code of conduct, health and safety, equal opportunities and other relevant policies and procedures.
Embody the Save the Children values in practice of Accountability, Ambition, Collaboration, Creativity, and Integrity. Work according to Save the Children’s mandate and child focus.
Work according to any other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
Child protection and safeguarding requirements
Maintain a child safe environment at the workplace and safeguard children’s rights, acting in the best interests of children at all times.
Maintain compliance with Save the Children’s
Child Safeguarding Policy
,
Code of Conduct
, and PSEAH policies and reporting processes among staff and volunteers.
Act as a role model by demonstrating highest standards of behavior towards children in private and professional life.
Never abuse the position of trust that comes with being a part of the Save the Children family.
Maintain a safe and positive relationship at all times when working with children and young people.
Respond to any concerns for the safety or wellbeing of a child in a program in accordance with internal reporting processes.
Health, safety, security and risk management
Be a role model for safety and security and comply with all workplace safety policy, procedure, work instructions and training.
Act safely at all times.
Report all incidents, injuries and potential hazards in a timely manner.
Participate in, and contribute to, health and safety awareness and improvements.
Be aware of, and consider, the risks associated with one’s daily work and apply appropriate mitigation measures in line with Save the Children’s policies and procedures.
All roles at Save the Children contribute to our impact for children.
At Save the Children, every role, whether in our programs or support services, plays a vital part in our impact for children. We are committed to creating a positive impact on the lives of children and their communities, and we value the contributions of every team member in achieving this vision.
Person Specification
It takes all types of people to do the challenging work we do. Here are some of the specific skills and experiences you’ll bring in this role:
Mandatory Qualifications and Accreditations
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Development Studies, Public Health, Social Sciences). Master’s degree is an advantage.
Minimum of five (5) years of experience in project management, preferably in social protection or nutrition programs.
Strong understanding of cash transfer programs and their implementation in developing contexts
Excellent leadership and team management skills.
Proven ability to work effectively with government stakeholders and diverse partners.
Proven ability to work effectively in complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Ability to think strategically, prioritize, problem-solve, and meet deadlines in a complex and challenging environment; must be culturally sensitive.
Excellent coordination and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and negotiate clearly and effectively at all levels and with a range of stakeholders (e.g., communities, government, donors). Proven external coordination and representation skills at a senior level.
Exhibit a strong work ethic with a high degree of flexibility with respect to working hours; ability to effectively plan and manage own time under pressure.
Excellent writing and verbal skills in English for reports and communications documents. Ability to present complex information in a succinct and compelling manner. Proficiency in Tok Pisin.
Familiarity with the local context and culture of the assigned province.
Additional Information

jobs.description:
PNG's pioneering leader in logistics and property.
Develops staff; invests in PNG's health & education.
Offers stable, rewarding careers with long-term growth.
The Opportunity
This organization is known as a pioneering icon and diversified leader in Papua New Guinea's development, having grown from a single-vessel trading operation into one of the country's largest private employers by diversifying across shipping, transport, property, and hospitality.
This is a perfect opportunity if you are a detail-oriented, proactive professional with a strong background in data analysis and reporting within the logistics, transport, or shipping industry. This role is ideal for those looking to elevate their career by automating reporting tasks, streamlining data processes, and directly impacting business strategy to improve operational efficiency and customer service delivery.
The Role
Your core mission is to drive the organization's success by transforming raw logistics and shipping data into actionable insights that enhance operational efficiency, optimize fleet performance, and drive strategic decision-making. You will be directly responsible for developing and maintaining key reports and dashboards using tools like Power BI and Azure, ensuring data integrity and compliance with regulatory standards, and collaborating with operational and finance teams to streamline reporting processes and contribute to informed management decisions.
Main duties include:
Report Development and Maintenance: Create and maintain reports and dashboards, specifically using tools like Power BI and Azure, including the preparation of monthly Balanced Scorecards.
Data Collection and Validation: Compile and verify data from logistics systems and external sources (like Excel and delivery schedules) to ensure accuracy.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with the four operating companies (OpCos) and finance teams to understand their reporting needs and deliver customised solutions.
Process Optimisation: Identify and implement solutions to automate routine reporting tasks (e.g., daily updates) and streamline data processes to improve responsiveness.
Documentation and Training: Create a repository of data sources, capture operational details (Standard Operating Procedures), and train end-users on reporting functions and data integrity.
Data Integrity and Security: Uphold the accuracy and confidentiality of data, ensuring compliance with both company policies and Papua New Guinea's regulatory standards.
Qualification and Experience:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Accounting or Finance.
2-4 years of experience in MIS, reporting, or data analysis, ideally within the logistics, transport, or shipping industry.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong experience with reporting tools like Power BI or similar platforms. Familiarity with logistics software (Cargowise, TM Master, Cadi) or SQL is a strong advantage.

About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.

In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our commercial team, the Team Lead – Contracts provides leadership and guidance to the Contracts team, ensuring high standards of contract administration, negotiation, and compliance. This role combines mentoring of team members with a strong technical focus, taking a lead role in procurement planning and market engagements under the direction of the Principal and Superintendent – Contracts. The position plays a pivotal role in achieving effective commercial outcomes, strengthening supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable legislation.
Key Accountabilities

Provide day-to-day leadership, mentoring, and guidance to Contracts Officers, fostering capability development and professional growth.
Allocate tasks, set priorities, and oversee workload to ensure deadlines and quality standards are consistently met.

jobs.title: University Librarian
jobs.description:
PAPUA NEW GUINEA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
The Papua New Guinea University of Technology is located in the industrial city of Lae, the second largest city in Papua New Guinea.  The city of Lae has an airport with flights to any location in PNG. The University is the only technological university in the country.  It has a main campus and three amalgamated colleges.  The main campus has 14 academic departments including one in Open and Distance Learning (ODL).  It offers undergraduate and graduate programs in engineering, natural and applied sciences, built environment, language and business.  The university has an Information Technology Services department and a Library.
MATHESON LIBRARY
Matheson Library, named after the first Chancellor of the University, which was founded in 1967. It has a current book stock of 130,000 volumes and receives 600 periodical titles. It is the only library in the university serving some 250 academic staff and 3,000 full time students taking a range of degree, diploma and certificate courses in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, Mining, Communication Engineering, Business Studies, Architecture and Building, Surveying and Land Studies, Mathematics and Computer Sciences, Applied Sciences, Applied Physics, Forestry, Agriculture and Communication and Development Studies.
The library system is automated and it operates 7 days a week with limited operation during weekends. The library seeks to appoint a suitably qualified and highly experienced person to immediately fill the following vacancy.
UNIVERSITY LIBRARIAN
The University Librarian is responsible for the overall management and development of library services, collections, budget and staff.  The University is concerned that it gains access to the information superhighway and its new Librarian will be expected to accelerate this process.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Efficient Information Literacy and Accessibility.
Ensure that Students and Staff have access to library resources effectively and resourcefully and at the same time students and staff are well inducted on the library operations.
2.
Well Maintained Accessibility Resources Center.
All electronic accessibility equipment, books and journals are readily available for staff and students. All library books and journals are acquired on time for students and staff.
3. Academic Success for Students and Staff.
To maintain continuous flow of information between academic departments and students required for research and study.
4.Research Impact
.
Ensuring all PNGUoT research articles and papers are well preserved
5

●
Maintaining a decent professional relationship with other libraries in the country and overseas for inter-         library loan purposes.
6.Capacity development of fellow colleagues
Continuously mentoring of library staff skills and knowledge to be able to better serve staff, students and other clients.
7. Actively participate in Policy development for the library.
Qualifications & Experience
A relevant master’s degree and an internationally recognized professional qualification in librarianship.
Required to have experience working in academic or research libraries and operational concepts involved in the delivery of users and bibliographic services and library automation.
Must be able to manage emerging trends in academic libraries especially those resulting from electronic access to information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, business skills and good interpersonal skills

It expects prompt, effective, and legally sound advice to support its management and staff, ensuring all legal issues are resolved in the most cost-efficient manner. The role is based in Port Moresby.
This is the perfect opportunity if you're a self-motivated , well-organised professional with 8+ years of post-admission experience in commercial and civil litigation. You'll get to elevate your career by managing and running all in-house litigation matters , providing sound and practical advice to the business, and utilizing your excellent analytical and legal research skills to navigate a complex and dynamic environment within an organization undergoing significant and rapid change.
The Role
This pivotal role involves providing legal support on all litigation matters, analyzing issues to identify legal problems, and advising on and representing the corporation in dispute resolution and potentially litigious matters. You'll manage and run all in-house litigation, conduct research, and provide instructions to external legal counsel. The overall objective is to deliver legally sound advice in the most effective and cost-efficient manner.
Main duties include:
Providing legal service to the business functions of the corporation on all litigation matters.
Managing and running all in-house litigation matters in consultation with the Head of Legal.
Conducting research on all litigious matters and determining information, counsel, and guidance on legal issues.
Advising on and representing the corporation on matters requiring dispute resolution and those that are potentially litigious or under litigation.
Managing and providing instructions in consultation with the Head of Legal to external legal counsel in litigation.
Preparing and providing monthly updates on the Legal (Litigation) Register.
Advising the Business on legal developments in PNG and within the region that impact its litigation matters in Court.
Qualification and Experience:
Bachelor of Laws Degree and a Certificate of Admission to the Supreme and National Courts of Papua New Guinea.
Admitted to practice law in the National and Supreme Courts of Papua New Guinea.
Current member of the PNG Law Society.
8+ years post admission experience / practice in commercial and civil litigation.
Demonstrable post-admission experience in finance and banking and commercial and corporate litigation.
Excellent analytical and legal research skills, with strong advocacy skills.
Ability to identify commercial solutions and provide sound and practical advice.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to operate effectively in a multicultural environment undergoing significant and rapid change.
Prior banking and finance experience is advantageous (but not a requirement).

jobs.industry: Mining, Oil and Gas, Mining, Oil and Gas
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining the Power System team and reporting to the Senior Electrical Engineer - Power Generation, this role covers Kainantu Gold Mine’s Permanent Power Station, Temporary Power Station, Kumian Camps Power Generation, 800L Portal Power Distribution Systems and associated controls, you will be responsible for the Production, Transformation & distribution of Power across the HV Network. This role, under the direction of the Senior Electrical Engineer, will contribute to the design, implementation, and management of power generation and transmission projects for Kainantu Gold Mine.
The Electrical Engineer shall provide engineering leadership to the Generation & Distribution Network and will assist the business to achieve project objectives and deliver on its Asset Management Policy. Additionally, the role supports the Asset Management team to deliver the best outcome for the range of developing and existing energy generation assets.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensure all statutory electrical inspections and works are carried out on plant site surface electrical equipment safely and within compliance with relevant laws, regulations and company standards.
Maintaining all electrical documentation and records. These include equipment specifications, data sheets, as build drawings, scope of works, change of management, and report writing.
Carry out engineering study, estimates, prepare technical drawings, P&IDs, E&I Schematics/SLDs, and specifications of electrical and control systems, procurement, and ensure installation conform to standards, project requirements, and safe operational requirements.
Communicates exceptionally within the team and in cross-functional work with other departmental sections and groups.
Assist with diagnosing electrical defects or hazards on systems, plant, and equipment, and identify adjustments, repair timely, and drive team to take key learnings.
Identify areas of sustainable improvement and drive to improve plant and equipment up time.
Assist with budgeting to meet plant and equipment operational requirements.
Perform reliability and maintenance of alarms, safety devices, and emergency electrical systems onsite.
Perform, enhance, and support the following functions as an Engineer:
Scoping, challenging and technical oversight/support for electrical design and site works associated with Power Generation under the Senior Electrical Engineer’s directions.
Maintain key relationships with Equipment Manufacturers, Service Providers and Industry Groups associated with Power Generation Equipment
Work within and support the Technical Authority Framework compliance as a Subject Management Expert
Review, justify and communicate recommendations for equipment selection, installation, operation and maintenance
Work collaboratively across relevant business areas in the development of commercial strategies and modes of operation to deliver design and performance improvements (for example, provision of ancillary services)
Reviewing and analysing SCADA data to assess the performance of operating power generating facilities.
Contribution to the development, review and ongoing support of asset management strategies and processes to ensure fleet equipment meets their intended design life at the lowest sustainable life-cycle costs
Under the guidance of the Senior Electrical Engineer, develop procedures and technical documentation regarding safe, reliable, and efficient operations and maintenance of power Generation equipment
Work closely with the asset digital team to develop performance analytics and monitoring strategies including predictive analytics
Develop professional relationships and effectively work with personnel across departments in an integrated organisation in performance of duties
Ensure health and safety, and environmental performance meets or exceeds company and regulatory requirements.
Ensure risk management plans are regularly reviewed and management actions are delivered; an
Address risk management as part of all material decisions taken.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Degree qualified or equivalent tertiary qualifications in Electrical engineering or related discipline.
Relevant work experience in similar roles in power generation and distribution.
Knowledge in the maintenance of HV Equipment, electrical, electronic, and instrumental equipment commonly installed in Power Stations.
Electrical engineering experience with low and high voltage equipment
Experience with CMMS Pronto platforms is well regarded.
Safety focus for people and equipment
Experience in Asset Management through Asset Management Procedures and Programs
Computer proficiency in MS Office suite.
Sound planning, analytical and critical thinking skills.
Initiative-taking with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

The Document Controller plays a crucial role in managing and overseeing all project-related documentation within the design and construction processes. This role ensures that all documents, including drawings, reports, and correspondence, are accurately maintained, distributed, and archived in accordance with the company's policies and procedures.

Manage and maintain all project documentation in an organized, accurate, and timely manner.

Maintain safe work standards and practices in accordance company policy.
Perform all roles and responsibilities that support and reflect the company’s mission and core values

A certificate or Diploma in business studies, Accounting or related field preferred but not essential

Good oral and written communication skills.
Flexible, adaptable and be a team player

Strong planning and organizational skills.
Proficient in computer use especially Microsoft suite, especially Excel and Outlook.

Mining Industry experience preferred.

jobs.title: Project Planner or Scheduler
jobs.industry: Construction, Building and Architecture, Project Management, Property and Real Estate
jobs.description:
Summary
The Project Planner / Scheduler is responsible for developing, monitoring, and updating the project schedule across all phases of construction. This role ensures alignment between time, cost, and resource planning to support on-time and on-budget delivery. The position requires close collaboration with engineers, quantity surveyors, and project managers to monitor performance and mitigate delays.
Duties and Responsibilities
1. Pre-Construction Stage
Develop the Master Project Schedule using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar tools.
Define the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), activity sequences, durations, and dependencies.
Identify project milestones, deliverables, and critical paths for effective tracking.
Support the preparation of manpower, material, and equipment forecasts.
Coordinate with the commercial and cost teams to ensure schedule-cost alignment.
Review cost estimates with quantity surveyors and estimators for scheduling accuracy.
2. Construction Stage
Monitor actual work progress against the baseline schedule and identify variances.
Update schedules regularly based on site conditions, change orders, or revised scopes.
Highlight potential delays and assess their impact on overall project timelines.
Coordinate with project teams to propose recovery plans when needed.
Generate weekly and monthly project progress reports with visual timelines and critical path tracking.
3. Post-Construction Stage
Prepare detailed close-out schedules to support final inspections and commissioning activities.
Analyze and compare planned versus actual performance data to assess overall schedule efficiency.
Develop delay analysis and Extension of Time (EOT) reports with supporting documentation for claims.
4. Final Completion & Handover
Ensure all project planning and scheduling records are updated and properly archived.
Document lessons learned and provide input to improve future scheduling methodologies and project planning processes.
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in project planning and scheduling.
Proficient in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or other recognized scheduling software.
Solid understanding of construction processes, project phases, and planning principles.
Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports and coordinating with project stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively under pressure in dynamic project environments.
Full-time position based at the project office with regular visits to construction sites.
May require occasional extended hours to meet reporting deadlines or resolve schedule issues.
Work may involve outdoor site inspections in varying weather and environmental conditions.

jobs.description:
PNG Air, renowned for its extensive network covering over 26 destinations throughout Papua New Guinea, operates a fleet of ATR 72-600 series aircraft. As the Airline of Choice, we're committed to delivering a world-class experience with competitive fares, unparalleled cargo rates, and a focus on safety and on-time performance for our valued customers and stakeholders.
FLIGHT DISPATCHER
We are pleased to announce an open vacancy now exists in our Flight Operations Department for a qualified and experienced Flight Dispatcher.
Based in Port Moresby this position will report to the Flight Dispatch Team Leader. The Flight Dispatcher shall be responsible for ensuring successful and timely completion of all allocated flight dispatch duties.
The Flight Dispatcher will be responsible for the following key responsibilities:
Compiling, interpreting, and disseminating weather and NOTAMS for all air operations.
Generating all domestic computerised and manual flights plans for company aircraft.
Providing flight dispatch support for all scheduled and non-scheduled flights.
Conducting flight following of all flight movements.
Providing updated weather, NOTAMs, and any pertinent information to continuing flights as applicable.
Maintaining, registering, and updating flight operations document in the fleet office, flight dispatch library, and flight crew room and aircraft libraries; maintaining stocks of consumables.
Arranging international diplomatic and airways clearances for outbound and inbound ferries, charters, and extra services.
Allocating and collecting Electronic Flight Bags (applicable to aircraft type).
Assisting in schedule recovery plans with reference to NOTAM and weather interpretation and re-planning
Monitoring and attending to incoming messages and enquiries referred to Flight Dispatch.
Maintaining current Operational notice boards.
Other duties as delegated by the Flight Dispatch Supervisor.
To be considered, you must have the relevant qualifications, skills, knowledge and experience:
Previous experience in the Aviation industry
Grade 12 or higher completion or equivalent qualification
Document control knowledge and understanding
Completed medical to verify fitness for work
Auditing experience (not required but it is an advantage)
Strong level in MS Suites especially Excel and Word.
Strong Attention to detail
Good organization and planning skills
Problem analysis and problem solving skills
Able to manage own workload, set and meet deadlines and operate independently with minimum level of supervision.
Hardworking, trustworthy and result focused
Knowledge of workplace Safety and understanding
Having Business management qualification is a bonus
If you feel you meet our requirements and are interested, we would like to hear from you. Send your application in only one PDF file to:
[email protected]
.
Applications close:
Friday 7th November  2025
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
We are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Escort & Emergency Response Team Leader
jobs.description:
Summary
The Escort & Emergency Response Team Leader plays a critical role in safeguarding people and property by leading emergency preparedness and patrol coordination. The role ensures efficient incident handling, digital reporting, resource readiness, and secure escort of personnel and sensitive materials. A focus on digital tools, professional conduct, and sustainable practices is key to success in this role.
Duties and Responsibilities
Lead, train, and supervise emergency response and patrol teams during drills and actual incidents.
Escort staff, visitors, VIPs, and sensitive materials securely during emergencies or high-risk situations.
Digitally manage and maintain emergency and patrol equipment (e.g., radios, med kits, evacuation tools).
Coordinate closely with police, fire, medical, and other emergency services as needed.
Implement and regularly review emergency response procedures to ensure safety and efficiency.
Respond promptly to incidents, alarms, and threats; ensure clear action plans for evacuation or containment.
Use digital platforms for incident logging, communication, and shift reporting.
Plan and lead emergency drills, debriefings, and readiness checks with structured follow-ups.
Support sustainability efforts by optimizing resource use, reducing waste, and using energy-conscious tools and methods.
Job Requirements
High School Certificate or Diploma in Security, Safety Management, or related field preferred.
First Aid, CPR, or Basic Life Support (BLS) certified, or willingness to obtain.
3–5 years in security, military, police, or emergency response roles.
Leadership experience in fast-paced or high-risk environments.
Experience coordinating with external emergency services is an advantage.
Background in structured security and safety environments is preferred.
Strong leadership and confident decision-making under pressure.
Clear communication, both spoken and written.
Quick assessment and implementation of effective actions during emergencies.
Familiarity with emergency protocols and threat assessment procedures.
Comfort with digital tools such as radios, surveillance systems, mobile apps, and access control software.
Ability to remain calm and act quickly in emergencies.
Capable of lifting and handling emergency equipment.
Willingness to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Others
The role promotes the company’s direction toward paperless operations, efficient use of resources, and structured workplace practices. The team leader is expected to lead by example in maintaining professionalism, using digital systems, and upholding a safe, clean, and well-organized work environment.

jobs.industry: Mining, Oil and Gas, Mining, Oil and Gas
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This position is responsible for the service and maintenance of heavy underground equipment in a safe and appropriate manner. This includes Trucks, Drills, Front-end loaders, Dozers, Mobile cranes (45T & 100T), and other pieces of equipment.
Key Accountabilities
Undertaking scheduled servicing and preventative maintenance of the company's heavy vehicle fleet, including Sandvik, CAT and Normet vehicles and equipment.
Respond to machinery breakdowns promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.
Servicing and preventative maintenance on Jumbos, Loaders and Trucks.
Diagnosis and troubleshooting of faults, and recommending servicing interventions that improve the operational efficiency of the company's heavy vehicle fleet
Rectifying machinery breakdowns in an underground environment promptly and undertake quality repairs in a timely manner.
Ensuring completion of all shift paperwork including service sheets, work orders and daily shift reports.
Completing all JSA's, risk assessments and documentation to ensure all work is completed safely and as per schedule.
Give direction, coaching and technical assistance to Trade Assistant’s and apprentice.
About You
Qualifications & Experience
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a NATTB certified Trade Certificate in Heavy Equipment Fitting with 3+ years’ experience in mining environment or heavy construction industry. In addition to this, you will have
Experience with Mining Equipment like Drills, LHD Loaders, Caterpillar Equipment, Sandvik Equipment etc.
Experience fitter with hydraulics training background.
Experience in the use of Pronto will be advantageous.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

jobs.title: Executive Support Officer
jobs.description:
Summary
The Executive Office Support Officer provides high-level administrative support to the Executive Office Team Leader and the executive team. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion, and a proactive approach to managing a wide range of administrative tasks. The role includes delegating specific tasks to conveyancing support, handling license and permit applications, and supporting special projects and initiatives within the department and across other departments.
Duties and Responsibilities
Administrative Support:
Manage the executive’s calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.
Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents.
Coordinate and manage executive team meetings, including preparing agendas, taking minutes, and following up on action items.
Communication:
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external communications on behalf of the executive office.
Screen and direct phone calls, emails, and other communications to appropriate parties.
Maintain and update contact lists and databases.
Project Management:
Assist with the planning and execution of special projects and events within the department and across other departments.
Track project timelines and deliverables, ensuring deadlines are met.
Conduct research and compile data to support executive decision-making.
Office Management:
Maintain office supplies and equipment, ensuring the executive office is well-stocked and operational.
Organize and maintain electronic and paper files, ensuring confidentiality and easy access.
Coordinate with IT and facilities teams to address any office-related issues.
Travel Coordination:
Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, and transportation.
Prepare detailed travel itineraries and ensure all travel documents are in order.
Confidentiality and Discretion:
Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion.
Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, particularly concerning data protection and confidentiality.
Delegation of Work:
Delegate tasks to conveyancing support staff, ensuring clear instructions and deadlines.
Oversee the progress of delegated tasks, providing guidance and support as needed.
Ensure the completion of delegated tasks in a timely and accurate manner.
License and Permit Applications:
Handle the preparation and submission of license and permit applications.
Track the status of applications and follow up as necessary.
Maintain records of all applications and relevant documentation.
Special Projects and Initiatives:
Support the planning and execution of special projects and initiatives within the department.
Collaborate with other departments to support cross-departmental projects and initiatives.
Provide administrative support for strategic initiatives led by the executive team.
Departmental Support:
Assist other departments with administrative tasks as needed.
Coordinate with various departments to ensure smooth communication and collaboration.
Support departmental events, meetings, and activities.
Job Requirements
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field preferred.
Experience:
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in an executive support or similar administrative role.
Skills:
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks effectively.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
Professional demeanor and ability to work with high-level executives.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Others
Competencies:
Proactivity:
Anticipate the needs of the executive team and act accordingly.
Discretion:
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with care.
Flexibility:
Adapt to changing priorities and work under pressure.
Interpersonal Skills:
Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Design Architect
jobs.description:
Summary
The Senior Architect is central to the conceptualization, design, and execution of architectural projects. Their role is enhanced by their proficiency in BIM modeling using Navisworks and Revit, which aids in creating detailed and accurate architectural designs. They are responsible for developing architectural plans, coordinating with engineering teams, and ensuring design compliance with relevant codes and regulations. The Senior Architect utilizes their BIM expertise to oversee the architectural aspects of construction projects, ensuring a harmonious blend of aesthetic appeal and functional design, while mentoring junior architects and collaborating with various stakeholders.
Duties and Responsibilities
Lead the conceptualization and design phases of architectural projects, ensuring a balance between aesthetics and functionality.
Develop comprehensive architectural plans and specifications that meet client requirements and industry standards.
Utilize BIM software, particularly Navisworks and Revit, for advanced modeling, visualization, and analysis of architectural designs.
Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to integrate architectural designs with structural, MEP, and civil components.
Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal building codes, as well as adherence to sustainability and environmental guidelines.
Lead and mentor a team of junior architects and designers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
Manage client relationships, presenting designs and proposals, and gathering feedback for iterative development.
Oversee the architectural aspects of construction projects, from initial design through to completion, ensuring quality and design integrity.
Job Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture from an accredited institution.
Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in architectural design, with a proven track record in leading large-scale projects.
Strong proficiency in BIM tools such as Navisworks and Revit, with a portfolio demonstrating advanced modeling capabilities.
Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to effectively manage teams and client relationships.
Knowledge of current architectural trends, materials, and construction techniques.
Registered Architect (RA) or similar professional accreditation preferred.
Others
The Senior Design Architect position offers a challenging and rewarding opportunity to shape the built environment and make a significant impact on diverse architectural projects. We value creativity, technical excellence, and collaborative spirit in our team members.

jobs.description:
Summary
The Senior Liaison Officer is responsible for ensuring smooth coordination between the Design Department and external regulatory bodies, while also providing administrative and scheduling support to the Design Manager. The role involves managing development submissions, tracking approvals, and maintaining clear documentation for all communication and reports related to planning and design processes.
Duties and Responsibilities
A. Liaison and Regulatory Coordination
Act as the main contact point between the Design Department and authorities (e.g., NCDC, CEPA, Building Boards).
Manage all external submissions, including rezoning, EIS, site clearance, subdivision, and building permits.
Attend meetings with authorities and represent the Design Manager for follow-ups and negotiations.
Coordinate submission packages with drafting, technical, and planning teams.
Monitor timelines and keep internal teams informed on approval statuses.
Maintain a tracker for project approvals and compliance documentation.
Support and guide Junior Liaison Officers on regulatory submission processes.
B. Administrative Support to the Design Manager
Manage the Design Manager’s schedule and coordinate internal and external meetings.
Prepare agendas, take minutes, and follow up on action items for departmental meetings.
Draft correspondence, reports, and departmental communications.
Organize and maintain accurate records and project documentation.
Assist in preparing KPIs, timelines, and internal tracking documents for the Design Department.
Coordinate inter-department communication and follow-up on deliverables.
C. Communication & Reporting
Keep an updated log of all correspondence with external agencies.
Generate monthly and quarterly reports on submissions and liaison activities.
Draft briefing notes and regulatory updates for senior management.
Assist with project presentations and stakeholder workshops as required.

Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Planning, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Unitech or Polytech graduates preferred.

Summary
The Senior MEP Engineer plays a pivotal role in managing and coordinating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems within construction projects. Their responsibilities extend to designing, reviewing, and overseeing MEP systems, ensuring adherence to relevant codes and standards. With expertise in BIM modeling, particularly in Navisworks and Revit, they lead the integration of these systems into the overall building design. They coordinate with various stakeholders, lead BIM coordination meetings, and mentor junior staff, ensuring seamless integration and efficient functionality of MEP components within complex construction environments.
Duties and Responsibilities
Responsible for carrying out a variety of basic field duties at the job design related to the general construction and maintenance.
Study the project scope of works, Owner requirements, BOQ, project milestones, and specification from the supplied bid documents.
Take note of possible queries to be brought up to the owner for clarifications.
Conduct material inquiries with the related suppliers nominated by Procurement.
Evaluate contractor or supplier’s proposal to ensure conformity with project requirements.
Prepare estimates on manpower and construction tools & equipment to be utilized.
Acquire material submittals from selected suppliers and prepare submittals according to project requirements.
Provide technical directions to the construction to ensure designs and drawings are prepared according to project requirement.
Prepare design, drawing and technical requirements.
Utilize BIM (Building Information Modeling) to create, manage, and optimize building designs.
Collaborate with project teams using BIM tools, primarily Navisworks and Revit, for design coordination and clash detection.
Lead BIM coordination meetings and manage the BIM workflow within the project team.
Implement BIM best practices and standards in all design phases.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship in BIM processes to junior engineers and team members.
Carry out additional related works as directed by the Design & Planning Manager or Project Director.
Works with Design & Planning Manager or Project Director on instructions for any amendments to drawing documents and other related issues.
Job Requirements
Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Specialist Diploma in M&E Coordination will be an advantage.
A minimum of 12-15 years' experience in Design, development and consultant or real estate field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in a related engineering discipline, with a focus on BIM implementation in large-scale projects.
Technically sound on applicable codes, standards, and regulations based on AS/NZS and PNG Local Authorities.
Proficiency in BIM modeling, with at least an intermediate level of experience.
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Navisworks and Revit BIM Modeling software.
Demonstrated experience in managing BIM projects and coordinating multidisciplinary design teams.
Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to lead BIM discussions and resolve complex issues.
Familiarity with BIM standards, such as ISO 19650, and other relevant industry standards.

Ability to work under pressure and tight schedules.
Skills in Design, cost estimates, quantity takeoffs, and manpower requirements for proposals, forecast, and change orders.
Knowledge in Microsoft office and Auto CAD and other Engineering software.
High level of creativity, problem-solving skills, results orientation, communication skills and team playing abilities.
Fluent in English, oral and written.

Supervisor
Location: Lae, Morobe Province
Responsibilities:
OHSEQ Duties
:
Report to OHSEQ Manager
Heading all OHSEQ roles and duties to ensure Company Safety Policies and Procedures are efficiently implemented in all Company sites.
Having monthly meetings with Management concerning branch Safety issues and improvement.
Compiling and lodging insurance claim for Comprehensive & TPO claims to Insurer.
Heavily involved in dealing with Third Parties Motor Vehicle Accident (MVA) cases and resolve them amicably.
Compiling Insurance claims summary to Financial Controller and management, having regular meetings and updating.
Attend to all MVA accident/incident cases and do ICAM investigation analysis report.
Representing Company and attend all MVA court cases at Traffic court, District Court and Civil court/National Court.
Coaching and training OHSEQ Coordinator, Safety officers to upskill with the Safety Health, Environment & Quality function on day-to-day operations of the OHSEQ department.
Making sure safety officers, traffic controllers and other Safety reps to report all Safety issues and non-compliances behaviours to OHSEQ and Business Units.
Conducting monthly OHSEQ meetings with Safety officers and departmental Safety representatives to address branch Safety issues.
Ensure OHSEQ WHS yearly calendar objectives are implemented through all branches Lae, Pom & Honiara.
Conducting Risk Assessment and identifying potential risks and hazards in workplaces/sites thus develop new SOPs to Management for endorsement and implementation.
Conducting Route Risk Assessment (RRA) for existing highways and new roads and implement Company authorised speed limit geo-fencing with Master Systems to mitigate risks of accidents/incidents.
Conducting F2F and Zoom meetings with clients on Safety issues arises in Company operations.
Having regular meetings with respective Business Unit Managers and addressing their Safety issues confronting them in their operations.
Mandated to resolve and manage safety issues and complaints courteously and efficiently.
Conducting internal and external audits to meet requirements and achieve higher Standard.
Making sure Safety department staff conducting random alcohol breathalyser test daily and on suspicious occasions and provide report to each Business Unit Managers.
Step up and provide assistance/advices to all departmental safety issues with OHSEQ representative and Business Unit managers at respective BUs.
Responsible for conducting quarterly workplaces risk assessments and implement management planning to control and mitigate risks and hazards on-sites.
Conducting drivers cargo latching and unlatching and fork lift/reach stacker operators safety evaluation assessment.
Assist Training department and promote defensives driving and make awareness to new and upcoming drivers and all in respective BU’s Tool-Box-Talk. Continually focused on Safety awareness
(Take 5 approach = Stop-Think-Identify-Plan-Proceed)
.
Conducting new staff induction and site induction for contractors.
Overseeing OHS Coordinator and Safety officers conducting JSERA for review and issue of Work Permit/Permit To Work (PTW).
Responsible in organising sixth monthly service of all fire equipment (fire extinguisher, fire hose, fire hydrant, smoke detectors & etc) in Lae branch.
Responsible for conducting yearly Emergency Fire Drill and compile report to Management for Audit purposes.
Overseeing all Compliance licenses from Government Regulatory Departments for annual renewals.
Responsible in ordering annual Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) from Dunlop PNG for branch and assisting other branches for their PPE orders.
Always dress in company uniform and appropriate PPE, take pride in your appearance and that of your teams.
Responsible in providing advices to Company Safety Strategic Development plan and Strategy endorsement by Company Management.
Taking Lead in advocating and promoting accident/incident FREE month/year attitude.
Responsible for compiling Lae branch monthly OHSEQ Performance Analysis Report to Management and All for improvement and Compliance.
Mandated to overseeing ALL Staff, Supervisors, Managers and Management to 100% adhere to all Company Safety Policies and Compliance.
Be a role model to all staff on all Safety aspects and Company Policies.
Fly high with
YES,
WE CAN!
Attitude.
Obliged to have a Zero tolerance and report non-adherence to Company Policies or fraudulent activates.
DG Ops Function & Duties
:
Overseeing all DG operations and training and mentoring DG Ops Coordinator to his function.
Arranging DG monthly ops meetings with ops team and special Management meetings.
Ensuring all DG Customer objectives are achieved in accordance with their plans.
Overseeing DG Class 1/Explosives Police Clearance are prepared and lodged in time for Police Metropolitan Superintendent to endorse.
Ensure Safety team must conduct pre-departure checks for all DG trucks prior to commence DG tasks.
Liaise with Export team for DGs (Explosives/AN/ANE/Cyanide) are booked and handled properly with DG drivers to wharves.
Follow up with Import team for DGs (Explosives/AN/ANE/Cyanide) shipment ETA, Clearance and gate passes for Transport DG drivers to cart to its destination safely.
Training and mentoring DG ops admin to facilitate all DG documents in timely manner.
Providing Transport and Logistics advice to DG ops team for smooth operations.
Ensure all DG ops dockets and invoices are charged accordingly to clients.
MUST HAVE:
Qualification OHS officer level 1- 4 or preferred OHS Diploma.
Possess valid driving licence class 3, 6 or 4
Good on Excel spreadsheet, MS Microsoft & PowerPoint presentation

jobs.industry: Mining, Oil and Gas, Mining, Oil and Gas
jobs.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our Underground Mining team, this role involves the operation of long hole production drill rig, charging up production blast holes in the underground mine operation, and being able to drill and install cable bolting. You will ensure safe operations of the equipment to meet drilling targets and report any irregularities immediately, while upholding the Company’s Code of Conduct, by displaying the appropriate work attitude and teamwork.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Operate in compliance with site instructions, including Survey Memos, Geology direction, and Ground Support Standards.
Ensure equipment is safe to operate and kept in clean working order. Report any defects to the superintendent or fitters.
Report any accidents, incidents, or hazards to the superintendent immediately.
Assess ground conditions at the face and implement ground control according to site requirements.
Ensure compliance with all underground regulatory and mine standards.
Any other Mining Operations duties as delegated from time to time by the Mine Superintendent
Work closely with the Mining shift boss to assess performance and identify improvements to maximise results, reduce risk and minimise wastage of jumbo consumables.
Responsible for ongoing communication with supervisors.
Responsible for processing of detailed daily reports to the supervisors and his oncoming shift.
Responsible for housekeeping as per standard.
Maintain work relationship with all working crews during shift hours.
Responsible for stope charging, stope mining and rise mining.
Responsible for production drills – long holes.
Responsible for timbering and cable bolting.
Responsible to safely operate the equipment.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Possess current 5+ years plus of underground mining experience (Essential)
Must have a shot firers licenses or evidence to proof handling of explosives.
Must understand the different explosives and charging principles.
Relevant operating permits endorsed by the Site Registered Manager
Heavy Lifting/Manual Handling Training
Must have at least 3 or more years of Solo Operation on a production rig, pneumatic and or electric.
Must understand the critical components of the drill rig and the functions.
Must be trained and able to charge the drilled holes with explosives.
Has certified Miner certificate in area of handling hand drill machine.
Sound planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent trouble shooting skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills to meet deadlines.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Have a strong understanding of the mining cycle.
Flexible, adaptable and be a strong and proactive team player.
Ability to meet agreed schedules and deadlines.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. About the role
Joining our Underground Mining team you will be an integral part of K92’s Mine Control Centre (MCC). The SIC Officer will assist the Shift Supervisors and Mine Coordinators throughout the shift to optimse the outcomes in line with the weekly plan, using the information flowing through the MCC and the use of the live Deswik.OPS Gantt mine schedule.
The SIC Officer will collaborate with the Supervisors throughout the shift, guiding them on opportunities, status updates from the MCC, coordinating requirements from technical services and generally assisting wherever possible.
The SIC officer will prepare a draft 36-hour shift plan for the Supervisors in readiness for the shift hand over, manage Deswik.OPS live weekly schedules, maintain compliance to plan dashboards and have daily reports prepared with validated data.
In addition, the SIC Officer will be required to identify data driven improvement opportunities, using PowerBI dashboards and analytics of the data recorded into Deswik.OPS.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensure all personnel, contractors and visitors comply with site and contractual HSE requirements.
Ensure work is planned so it can be conducted safely, with consideration for environmental conditions, nearby activities, people, and other resources needed to complete the work.
Ensure housekeeping activities within and around the work area are performed to a high standard.
Actively promote a safety first, zero harm culture.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (HSE, Supervisors, Coordinators, Superintendents, MTS personnel, Mine Controllers) to support the Mining Supervisor to execute their responsibilities on a shift-by-shift basis.
Promote a data-driven continuous improvement by reviewing Power BI dashboards and completing data analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
Maintain, in real time the Deswik.OPS Gantt schedule through the shift to weekly time horizons,
Collaborate with the Mine Supervisors across the mine radio to prepare a detail 36-hour shift plan for review in each shift planning meeting.
Provide Supervisors with any mobile equipment status changes because of either Planned or Breakdown maintenance
In consultation with the underground supervisors, provide the Mobile Maintenance teams with clear priorities for break down repairs.
Inform the Supervisor of upcoming planning conflicts based on the live shift progress (on the Deswik.OPS Gantt), to proactive make changes throughout the shift, optimising the shift plan.
Coordinate with the Underground Supervisors to ensure shotcrete orders and delivery time frames are managed to achieve the shift and weekly objectives
Coordinate with the stores department to ensure consumables are available for the mining team to deliver the plan
Maintain the compliance to plan control charts (Development, Production, Slot Drilling) on the muster room dashboards, meeting rooms and daily reports
Maintain the end of week forecast of mining key physicals
The SIC Officer will maintain a dashboard and memo register to clearly identifying the upcoming requirement for development designs and survey control
Maintain KPI’s on a daily, weekly and monthly basis as defined in the K92 MOS
Produce delay Pareto charts each day, week and month to understand key operational improvement opportunities
Use the Deswik.OPS data and Power BI to identify continuous improvement opportunities
Use the Deswik.OPS data and Power BI to produce reports which measure the success of current CI projects.
Escalate delays through the K92 MOS escalation TARP as required
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Minimum of 3 years' experience in underground mining, with an in depth understanding of the mining cycle
Preferably tertiary qualifications in a Mining related field
High level of computer literacy in MS Office suite and data management
High degree of analytical, planning and scheduling skills
Strong communication skills with ability to communicate with wide range of disciplines on site
Experience in directing, monitoring and adjusting shift plans and reports
Experience in Deswik Software or Similar

K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.

Location:

Burnet Institute PNG
About the Burnet Institute
The Burnet Institute is an Australian medical research and public health organisation working to improve the health of vulnerable communities in Australia and globally. In Papua New Guinea, Burnet has operated for nearly two decades, partnering with provincial health authorities and local stakeholders to strengthen health systems, pilot innovations, and conduct research on priority health issues.
About the HEAL-PNG Project
HEAL-PNG is a three-year clinical trial funded by the NHMRC and the Global Alliance for Chronic Diseases (GACD). The project evaluates an innovative model of care that integrates non-communicable disease (NCD) screening and management within existing HIV and TB clinics in
Morobe
and
East New Britain
provinces. The goal is to improve NCD care through enhanced screening, patient education, adherence support via peer counselling, and simplified management protocols.
About the Role
The
Research Health Extension Officer (HEO)
will play a key role in establishing and implementing the HEAL-PNG trial across selected health facilities. Working closely with the Provincial Health Authority (PHA), facility staff, and the HEAL-PNG project team, the HEO will support study coordination, site setup, staff training, and data collection activities.
The position will require initiative, attention to detail, and the ability to build strong working relationships across multiple stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Coordinate study activities at participating facilities, ensuring adherence to research protocols and ethical standards.
Facilitate site onboarding, including assessments and staff training in NCD, TB, and HIV management.
Manage data collection, entry, and quality assurance in a confidential and timely manner.
Maintain strong communication with facility and PHA staff, fostering collaboration and problem-solving.
Support logistics for meetings, trainings, and field activities.
Assist with procurement, stock control, and management of project materials and consumables.
Qualifications and Experience
Essential:
Health Extension Officer qualification (Diploma + 1-year residency or Bachelor’s + 2-year residency).
Strong understanding of tuberculosis, HIV, and non-communicable diseases (diabetes, cardiovascular disease, asthma, COPD).
Competency in Microsoft Office applications.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in English and Tok Pisin.
Strong organisational skills and ability to work both independently and in a team.
Ability to build rapport with health staff and community members.
Willingness to be based in Morobe or East New Britain and work in field-based settings.
Punctual, reliable, and proactive.
Desirable:
Experience in clinical research or health program implementation.
Other Requirements
Compliance with Burnet Institute’s occupational health, safety, and safeguarding standards.
Police Check and Working with Children Check (as applicable).
How to Apply

cover letter and current CV
outlining how your skills and experience align with the position to:
